title: Synthesize robustness audit into implementation and test plan
description: Turn TASK-FC-027 through TASK-FC-043 findings into a sober implementation backlog and a separate test backlog.
objective: Create the next plan only after cross-cutting and per-filter audits identify what is fragile, what is missing, and what should be tested.
expected_outputs: Implementation backlog grouped by shared contracts, per-filter depth, and editor resilience
Test backlog grouped by PHP/schema, JS runtime, Elementor editor, visual containment, and Guilherme QA
acceptance_criteria: The synthesis ranks work by product impact, fragility risk, and dependency order.
The synthesis separates implementation tasks from tests instead of mixing both in one vague task.
The synthesis names which visual/editor checks belong to Guilherme and which checks Codex can perform mechanically.
The synthesis explicitly rejects one-off repairs that do not address the shared contract.
verification: All dependent audit reports exist or are marked blocked with reason.
No implementation work is included in this synthesis task.
risks: If synthesis starts early, it may recreate the same shallow plan before the code has been fully audited.
